headline: New wave of listings: Tashkent prepares companies for international markets
summary: The Uzbekistan Investment Fund is preparing major telecom, aviation, banking and energy companies for potential listings. Uztelecom is furthest ahead, as management reforms and new capital progress.
why: Uzbekistan is a Central Asian economy opening state-linked companies to foreign capital, which can create new offerings for international investors.
